title: Chinese ufology after Mao and the Falun Gong crackdown

tellings.quote: everything revolves around the the death of Mao Zong in 1976.

plain: The study of UFOs in China, a researcher named Richard Dolan tells Michels, opened up only after the death of Mao Zedong in 1976, and its story runs on to the government's crackdown on the Falun Gong spiritual movement in 1999. "Everything revolves around the death of Mao," Dolan says, drawing on the work of a writer named Paul Dong, though he gives few details of what followed.
